Field.name: AFileSubtractFrom
Field.usage: Input image file to subtract images from (file A)
Field.manpage: Input image file to subtract images from (file A). If this option is not entered, the first non-option argument will be used for this input file.

Field.name: BFileSubtractOff
Field.usage: Input image file B with images to subtract from A
Field.manpage: Input image file B with images to subtract from A. If this option is not entered, the second non-option argument will be used for this input file, if it exists. If this file is not specified at all, a backup file to A will be used (the A filename with ~ appended).

Field.name: OutputFile
Field.usage: Output file C for difference images (omit for statistics only)
Field.manpage: Output file C for difference images. If this option is not entered, the third non-option argument will be used for this output file, if it exists. If this file is not specified at all, only statistics will be reported for each section.

Field.name: DifferenceTextFile
Field.usage: Output file for a copy of the difference statistics
Field.manpage: Output file for a copy of the difference statistics, which will still be printed to standard out. The file will include the header line and "all" line.

Field.name: ModeOfOutput
Field.usage: Mode for output file (1 for integers, 2 or 12 for floating point)
Field.manpage: Mode for output file (1 for signed integers, 2 for 32-bit floating point, or 12 for 16-bit floating point). Bytes (mode 0) are rarely suitable for a difference image since they are unsigned, as is mode 6. The default is the mode of the input file, although the default mode of floating point output for MRC files is governed by the value of environment variable IMOD_WRITE_FLOATS_16BIT. Mode 12 is allowed only if the output format is MRC.

Field.name: ASectionList
Field.usage: List of sections in file A (numbered from 0, default is all sections)

Field.name: BSectionList
Field.usage: List of sections in file B (numbered from 0, default is all sections)
Field.manpage: List of sections in file B. Sections are numbered from 0. The default is to use the first N sections in the file, where N is the number of sections in the list for file A.

Field.name: ZeroMeanOutput
Field.usage: Subtract mean difference for each section to make mean output 0
Field.manpage: Make the mean of the output be zero for each section by subtracting the mean difference between sections from the difference.

Field.name: LowerThreshold
Field.usage: Truncate output to eliminate values below this threshold
Field.manpage: Truncate the output by replacing values below this theshold with the threshold value.

Field.name: UpperThreshold
Field.usage: Truncate output to eliminate values above this threshold
Field.manpage: Truncate the output by replacing values above this theshold with the threshold value.

Field.name: StatisticsXminAndMax
Field.usage: Minimum and maximum X for computing reported statistics (numbered from 0)
Field.manpage: Minimum and maximum X for computing the minimum, maximum, mean and SD of the difference that are reported in the output. Coordinates are numbered from 0; the default is the full area in X.

Field.name: StatisticsYminAndMax
Field.usage: Minimum and maximum Y for computing reported statistics (numbered from 0)
Field.manpage: Minimum and maximum Y for computing the minimum, maximum, mean and SD of the difference that are reported in the output. Coordinates are numbered from 0; the default is the full area in Y. This entry and the next one do not affect the size of the output images; use Clip(1) to obtain a difference volume from a subarea in one step.

Field.name: FractionalValues
Field.usage: Output summary statistics as fractions of the input data range
Field.manpage: Output an additional line expressing the summary statistics for all sections as fractions of the data range of the two input files.

Field.name: ErrorMinMaxLimit
Field.usage: Exit with error if absolute value of min or max exceeds this value
Field.manpage: Exit with error if the absolute value of the minimum or maximum exceeds the given value, over the region where statistics were computed.

Field.name: ErrorSDLimit
Field.usage: Exit with error if overall standard deviation exceeds this value
Field.manpage: Exit with error if the overall standard deviation over the region where statistics were computed exceeds the given value.

Field.name: ParameterFile
Field.manpage: Read parameter entries as keyword-value pairs from a parameter file.
